mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own vessels was especially worthwhile: the planned cutaway distinguishes blood in the chambers from the separate supply needed by the thick heart muscle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the systemic network felt comparatively thin: the resulting picture description showed two loops but gave little detail about their connections.

surprise.text: The coronary supply was a useful distinction: chamber blood alone cannot feed all the heart muscle. The coronary sinus is named without an explanation, though its return to the right atrium is shown.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the valve slots and vessel descriptions gave the combinations clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how the connected circulation supports exchange with tissues; the valve and coronary constructions made structure and function clear.
